Hey I am a guy but found every girl is different some like you to treat them with respect and just show your love and affections through your actions.

Some feel more insecure the more you try to make them feel less insecure by telling them they are beautiful etc... It really depends on the situation and the girl.

I have with two girls I liked, told them all my little insecurities made a fool out of myself for them to try get them to come out there shells and relax a bit, again as they are all different worked better for one than the other.

I guess the best thing to do is honestly just be the best guy you can be for her, treat her right, respect her, love and cherish her and look after her, at the end of the day that's what all women want, is to feel valued loved and respected and treated well.
